body:
## Outcome

Completes gpui-rhai 0.1.8 as one final Interaction Runtime release rather than supported intermediate states.

## Runtime

- one Host-domain gesture/pointer-capture/application-drag coordinator
- atomic native preview patches and typed PrimitiveContext
- shared affine Canvas paint/hit-test/local-coordinate path
- stable collection grouping, outline projection, virtual neighbor anchors and active-drag pinning
- retained callback call-depth fix for #80 without relaxing synchronous recursion

## Public components

Adds Draggable, DragSource, DropZone, Sortable, PanZoom, SelectionArea, Rotatable, RangeSlider and Tree. Resizable, SplitPane, Table resize, Slider, Scrollbar and Chart use the shared interaction foundation.

## Acceptance

- 457 workspace tests
- 31 CLI tests
- 133 native interaction/accessibility/lifecycle tests
- strict all-feature and default-feature Clippy
- rustdoc with warnings denied
- package verification for all three 0.1.8 crates
- complete macOS release smoke and 69 visual baselines
- release benchmark: 5 warmups / 30 samples; 100k Chart streaming remains 0 Rhai operations per revision
- `workbench/interaction-lab` mounts the whole interaction set and completes a real DragSource → DropZone workflow

## Boundaries

Runtime API stays 2. DockLayout, OS/cross-window drag, arbitrary GPUI subtree scaling, 3D and additional platform certification remain explicitly out of scope.

Closes #80 and #82 when merged.
title: Release 0.1.8 unified Interaction Runtime
